varieties.name: Fordhook Giant
varieties.season: Year-round; "plant on beds or ridges in the summer if possible"
varieties.traits: Dark glossy green, deeply savoyed leaf, broad white stems; wide adaptability; "the most used variety in South Africa"
varieties.note: The default, nationally-dominant chard/'spinach' variety in SA home and market gardens — sold as open-pollinated by both Starke Ayres and Sakata, so seed can be saved.

evidence.quote: Fordhook Giant has a dark glossy green leaf colour. Fordhook Giant takes 58 days to mature after seedling transplant... This swiss chard variety is the most used variety in South Africa.
evidence.doc: Fordhook Giant, Sakata product page (fetched directly, verbatim)

evidence.quote: Outstanding Qualities Good colour High yield potential Harvest ready as soon as 58 days after transplant Wide adaptability
evidence.doc: Fordhook Giant, Sakata product page (fetched directly, verbatim)

varieties.name: Bright Lights
varieties.traits: Ornamental multi-coloured (yellow/red/white) stems on large green leaves; 40-60 day maturity per search snippet
varieties.note: A decorative/edible dual-purpose chard sold nationally by Starke Ayres alongside Fordhook Giant; not restricted to a particular zone in the source found.

evidence.quote: produces large green leaves with a mix of yellow, red and white stems... germinates in 10-14 days with maturity in 40-60 days, and can be grown year-round in full sunlight or semi-shade
evidence.doc: Bright Lights, Starke Ayres product page (via search snippet — JS-rendered page, not directly fetchable for a verbatim on-page quote)

gaps: Both varieties are marketed as nationally adapted with only a sowing season attached (matching crop-catalog.ts's own near-year-round sow windows for this crop), not a growing zone — zoneAdvice is therefore left empty rather than invented.

Sakata also sells 'Eldorado', 'Rhubarb' and 'Silverado' swiss chard (seen in its product catalogue listing) but these were not individually opened/quoted in this pass; listed here only as a lead for a follow-up pass, not as sourced entries.
OP/hybrid status for Bright Lights is not stated in the (unverifiable, JS-rendered) source found — left null rather than assumed.
